items.t: Windshield wipers work on and off (recall)
items.job: Replace windshield wiper motor
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Power mirror switch can short and overheat (recall)
items.job: Repair power mirror switch circuit (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Front brake rotors can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace front brake rotor and hub assembly
items.note: Price is per side. Free under GM's recall if not done. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: "Spider" fuel injector unit clogs or leaks
items.job: Replace central (spider) fuel injector assembly
items.note: The updated injector unit is the usual fix. Fix fuel leaks right away because of fire risk.

items.t: Intake manifold gasket coolant leak
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and coolant
items.note: Cost rises a lot if coolant in the oil damaged the engine bearings.

items.t: 4L60-E automatic slipping or failing
items.job: Replace with remanufactured 4L60-E transmission
items.note: A shop rebuild costs about the same. Smaller fixes like a valve body or solenoid cost much less.

items.t: Rusted brake lines
items.job: Replace rusted brake lines (full preformed line set)
items.note: Price is for replacing all the steel lines. Fixing one short section costs much less. Rusted fittings can add time.

items.t: Fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace fuel pump module
items.note: The tank usually has to be lowered. A fuller tank adds time.

items.t: Fuel pump wiring connector overheats (recall)
items.job: Repair fuel pump wiring and connector
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Exhaust fumes can enter the cabin (recall)
items.job: Install missing body and wheelhouse plugs
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Also check the exhaust for leaks.

items.t: Running board light wiring can overheat (recall)
items.job: Repair running board light wiring (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Crankshaft position sensor failure (recall)
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Clunk from the steering intermediate shaft
items.job: Replace intermediate steering shaft
items.note: Some shops first lubricate the shaft per GM bulletin, which costs less but the clunk may return.

items.t: ABS kicks in at low speed
items.job: Diagnose ABS and clean or replace front wheel speed sensor
items.note: A GM recall may cover this. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer. On some trucks the sensor comes with the hub.

items.t: Instrument cluster gauges stick or quit
items.job: Rebuild instrument cluster (replace gauge stepper motors)
items.note: Mail-in rebuilds are cheapest. Ask a dealer whether old GM special coverage applies; it has likely expired.

items.t: Hydraulic brake booster problems (recall)
items.job: Replace hydraulic brake booster
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Fuel rail parts can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel rail damper clip or fuel rail
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Do not drive with a fuel smell.

items.t: Heated washer fluid system fire risk (recall)
items.job: Disable or replace heated washer module (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: V8 burns oil
items.job: Replace pistons and rings (GM oil consumption fix)
items.note: Shops often try a valve cover/PCV fix or AFM disable first, which costs far less. Engine replacement costs much more.

items.t: Collapsed cylinder deactivation lifter
items.job: Replace valve lifters and camshaft
items.note: Newer SUVs may be under powertrain warranty. Engine damage from metal debris raises the cost a lot.

items.t: Cracked dashboard
items.job: Replace upper dash pad
items.note: A molded dash cover that fits over the cracks is a much cheaper fix.

items.t: Ignition key can stick in Start (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition lock actuator and key (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Steering gear shaft can fracture (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace steering gear
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Do not drive if steering feels loose.

items.t: Shifter can leave Park without the brake (recall)
items.job: Repair steering column shift lock (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Some trucks need a new steering column.

items.t: Body control module can short and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace body control module (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Module programming is included in the time.

items.t: Rear brake caliper bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten rear brake caliper bolts
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Hard brake pedal from vacuum pump problems (recall)
items.job: Replace brake vacuum pump
items.note: Often free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: A/C stops cooling from a condenser leak
items.job: Replace A/C condenser and recharge system
items.note: GM special coverage may pay for this. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer first.

items.t: Electric power steering can cut out (recall)
items.job: Power steering repair or software update (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM recall; check your VIN. A few SUVs needed a new steering gear, which costs much more if not covered.

items.t: Transmission cooler line can leak (recall)
items.job: Reseat or replace transmission cooler line fitting
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Clean up any spilled fluid.

items.t: Unexpected braking on one side (recall)
items.job: Update brake control software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Air bags may not deploy during a self-test (recall)
items.job: Update air bag module software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Front control arm welds may fail (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Replace front upper control arms
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Includes an alignment.

items.t: Transfer case missing a part (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace transfer case if needed (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. Do not drive it until the check is done.

items.t: Rear seat belts may not lock for child seats (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear seat belt retractors
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Fuel pump missing pressure regulator (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump module
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Power steering assist can drop out (recall)
items.job: Update power steering software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer. May also be done over the air.

items.t: Fuel pump control module can cause stalling (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump power control module
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Rear driveshaft may break (recall)
items.job: Replace rear driveshaft assemblies
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Rear wheels can lock up (recall)
items.job: Reprogram transmission control software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Third-row seat belts can be damaged (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace third-row seat belt buckles
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Daytime running lights stay on with headlights (recall)
items.job: Update body control module software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: 6.2L V8 rod or crankshaft failure (recall)
items.job: Replace engine assembly
items.note: Covered by GM's L87 recall for affected SUVs. Check your VIN or ask the dealer before paying for anything.

items.t: Rear control arm bolts can break (recall)
items.job: Replace rear suspension control arm bolts
items.note: Free under GM's recall. Check your VIN first or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Wrong front hub bolts can work loose (recall)
items.job: Replace front wheel hub bolts, both sides
items.note: Free under recall 26V-304. Check the VIN first. A hub damaged by loose bolts is extra.
